_comment: Activates the miragon-brand brand-lint hook for this repo (CLAUDE.md, Design system). designIQ's UI, docs and code are English, so the German copy rules are off (A*, S*, C5 'UI-Texte auf Deutsch' - a separate decision, see #238). The rest is not switched off, but the hook only lints colours: the palette (B1), in CSS also raw brand hex instead of --cd-* tokens (C1) and gradient text (U5). Logo, fonts, icons and the AI look are review items (miragon-brand:brand-review), not linted.
